question: What claim is made about a wise person who, while burning, acts with respect to the tip of nectar and the tip of essence?
premises: Reference is made to the tip of nectar.
Reference is made to the tip of essence by means of it.
A wise person is described as burning.
The particle also marks a concessive or emphatic point.
inference: Even a wise person, while burning, does so in relation to the tip of nectar and the tip of essence.
uncertainties: The verb governing the action is not present as a finite verb in this verse.
plain_english: Even a wise person, burning, at the tip of nectar with the tip of essence.
